receive-chute-nominal.basis: Battery-side source ranges. Drive 0-52 A covers the 60.07 A adverse replay bus total less pan and controls (limited-field-four-terminals lowestBus); steer 0-20 A from the 0.225 N m scrub-limited motor torque at 189 rad/s per module (four modules, timed-bus 9.5 A phase peak); pan bounded by its 30 A phase limit (docked) or the 7.45 A loaded-driving peak; controls 3-6.5 A for the 68 W auxiliary budget. Pack: fresh 12.4 V / 25 mOhm and screened 11.8 V / 27 mOhm (nominal), weak 11.8 V / 32 mOhm (experiments/six-wheel/conditioned-match/supply.py).
